lines: We started RMI Agentic just this May, and I'm currently serving as the Co-Founder and CTO.
Currently, our team has grown to almost 10 people—hiring has been really fast in the last few months.
I've spent about seven years at Credit Suisse, ending my time there as Vice President before starting my entrepreneurial journey.
As Lead Data Architect at NeoGrowth Credit, I led several AI architecture initiatives before moving on to this venture.
Humne pichle ek saal mein team triple kar di hai, ab hum kaafi bada scale manage kar rahe hain.
With a strong foundation in agentic AI, our founding team brings together deep expertise—my co-founders Mitesh Tank and Anoop John are serial entrepreneurs, while Rajani handles partnerships and GTM.
